How to explore

  • Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, right-drag to pan.
  • Click any asteroid/comet/planet to inspect; click Follow to track it through time.
  • Time: play, scrub, or pick a date. Bodies move on their true elliptical orbits (Kepler).
  • Filters dim everything else — PHAs in red, upcoming close approaches in gold, Sentry risks in orange.
  • Data from JPL SBDB / CNEOS, snapshot via data/. Sun radius 696 000 km.
